title: The Charts page reads weekly volume and the training calendar twice on every visit and throws one copy away
what: Each time the Charts page comes into view, the app reads the weekly lifted weight and the day-by-day training shading once inside the main bundle, then reads both again with the newer counting rule and drops the first copies. On a phone with years of workouts this is wasted work on every visit.
expected: Each number on the Charts page is read once per visit.
fix_line: Leave the old weekly volume and calendar reads out of the bundle the Charts page uses

items.reason: these are phone app parts; no panel web pages here (pagespeed.json covers the panel and websites)
no file in this area talks to the online database; the only read is one small table on the phone itself
